description: Plan and create original, hand-drawn 16:9 illustrations for Chinese articles, essays, blog posts, Notion notes, workflows, and methods. Use when users ask for article illustrations, visual metaphors, shot lists, Xiaohei-style drawings, or help editing an illustration. Start by finding the article's cognitive anchors; use a white canvas, sketchy black linework, restrained red/orange/blue annotations, and a small black character that performs the core action.
